name: PSC1 Practical Core v1
authority: Data-only projection of the finite contract and immutable Linux CI checkpoint; no admission, publication or changed-source authority.

acceptance.meaning: Exact Nat arithmetic, saturation and zero divisors; Int add/sub/mul; mixed numeric refusal.
Nat/Int proposition-valued order with independently admitted decisions; false/true and equal boundaries.
Fixed precedence/associativity; Bool short circuit skips divergence/error; typed equality rejects mismatches.
Expected types resolve numeric/empty-array/tuple/lambda contexts in both syntaxes.
Failed speculative alternatives restore meta state; ambiguous and unresolved terms refuse.
Reader/state/modify and old-value capture match the checked CompilerM library.
Unit/nested-product bindings compose with bind, once-only evaluation and scopes.
Nested do/lambda owns return; wrong state/error/result types refuse.
List/Array traversal order, once-only source, empty collections and state/error propagation.
Lower-inclusive upper-exclusive Nat range; endpoint order/once-only evaluation; reversed range is empty.
First action occurs without materializing all continuations; retained 100000-step bounded-memory application measurement.
Reevaluation, sequential/nested loops, mutation, return and typed catch use the current state.
Ordinary divergent loop is externally timed out; no injected runtime fuel; checked total owner refuses unproved loop.
Owned returned callbacks preserve old values through product/Array/Option storage.
Fixed types across branch/loop joins; shadowing/escaping-name/type-change policy enforced.
Handler restores lexical and effect state and continues outside the handler.
CompilerM finite range return skips continuation and preserves specified state.
Source return bypasses catch and skips remaining continuation.
Returns in nested branches/loops exit only their owner; grouped do/lambda has independent owner.
Ordinary constructive opaque witness exactly paired with checked executable graph; forged companion/axiom/uninhabited results refuse.
Direct, non-tail and higher-order recursion execute under unchanged limits; verified mode refuses without certificate.
Unit/grouping/right-associated products and nested named/wildcard patterns; RHS once in original scope.
Duplicate binders refuse; closures preserve original binding identity; strictness observes divergent RHS.
Persistent alias unchanged after set; optional empty/huge/OOB Nat lookup requires no element inhabitant.
Empty/literal/push/set/map/fold and receiver/index order evaluated once; wrong index/element types refuse.
Canonical List literals, length/append/reverse and empty case agree with Lean standard operations.
Canonical Except propagates typed errors and successful values.
Checked CompilerM recovery restores state.
Throw skips continuation; host/compiler failures never become source values.
Rethrow/nested binder/continuation scope and return bypass; malformed/mistyped handlers refuse.
Sequential dependent/intervening implicit telescopes; transactional nondependent expected-result constraints.
Ambiguity, arity and unresolved metas refuse; adjacent comma/native calls and explicit f(()) retained.
Nested/reopened/dotted declarations, current/enclosing/root lookup and local precedence preserve full identity.
Translation hygiene, duplicate/refusal tests; imports stay private and only entry declarations export.
Explicit typed capability: UTF-8 line read/write, EOF and newline; denied capability refuses before publication.
Root-confined bounded UTF-8 file read/write, exact size/encoding/path policy and typed failures.
All seven target adapters preserve portable semantics; unsupported ABI/configuration refuses before publication.

exclusions: Finite Practical Core v1 Linux qualification is not unrestricted Lean/language conformance.
No formal backend-preservation theorem or behavioral certificate is claimed.
G2/G3 self-compilation and fixed-point qualification remain separate manual work on finalized source; no result is inferred from G1 or this fix.
No manual workflow event, merge, registry publication or release upload is claimed.
